ideas.pain_point: YouTube commercials are torture for people with ADHD.

It intelligently mutes, pauses, or skips disruptive elements like ads on streaming platforms (e.g., YouTube), and can block notifications or specific websites during designated 'focus periods'. Users can create custom 'focus profiles' for different tasks, ensuring a more consistent and less interrupted digital experience.
ideas.core_features: Customizable ad-muting/pausing for YouTube/streaming, smart notification blocker, 'focus profiles' for different tasks, gentle visual cues for interruptions instead of audio, website blocker with timed access.
ideas.revenue_model: One-time purchase ($29.99) for lifetime access to the browser extension. Premium Desktop App ($4.99/month): Cross-device sync, advanced analytics on distraction patterns, AI-powered distraction prediction, and integration with productivity tools.
ideas.first_user_step: User installs the browser extension, navigates to YouTube, and the extension automatically mutes the next commercial, displaying a small, non-intrusive 'Ad Muted' notification in the corner of the screen.
ideas.target_user: Individuals with ADHD, students, remote workers, or anyone seeking to minimize digital distractions and maintain focus during tasks or content consumption.
